svg.text: Each decoder Dₖ only inverts its adjacent classifier block. Reconstructions from deep layers are built by cascading decoders back to pixel space.
① Training — one stage per decoder, sequentially
The classifier is frozen. We train D₁ first (image reconstruction), then D₂ to predict a₁, then D₃ to predict a₂. Each Dₖ only sees its own local target.
Frozen classifier forward pass (shared across all stages):

svg.text: ② Inference — cascade reconstruction for anomaly maps
All decoders frozen. For each level k, we chain Dₖ → Dₖ₋₁ → ... → D₁ to produce a pixel-space reconstruction x̂ₖ, then compute the residual map mₖ = (x − x̂ₖ)².

g.text: mean / max / weighted over m₁, m₂, m₃
image score = max pixel of M(x)
